title: Contracted Service Staff Standing in an Event Value
content:
Contracted service staff on a Private Event & Banquet Services event are counted up to the next whole member at the guests per server printed against the package, and charged at the staff rate per hour printed against the same package for the hours counted.

## Which count the staff are counted on

1. Where a confirmed guarantee entry stands on the booking and the count it guarantees reaches the smallest guest count printed against the package, the staff are counted on the guaranteed count.
2. Where no confirmed guarantee entry stands on the booking and the working count the booking was taken at reaches the smallest guest count printed against the package, the staff are counted on that working count.
3. Where neither count reaches the smallest guest count printed against the package, no contracted staffing stands in the value.

Counting up to the next whole member means that any part of a member is a whole member: at 20 guests to each member, 81 guests are counted as 5 members and 80 guests as 4.

## The three figures each package prints

| Package | Guests per service staff member | Service staff rate, USD per hour | Smallest guest count |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 34 | 4 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 25 | 36 | 10 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 20 | 38 | 25 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 16 | 42 | 60 |
| Gala Reception Package | 12 | 48 | 150 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 18 | 40 | 200 |

## Worked illustration on hypothetical records

A booking on the Seated Banquet Package carries a confirmed guarantee entry of 130 guests, and the hours counted for the event come to 7.0. At 16 guests to each member, 130 guests are counted as 9 members, a part member being counted as a whole one. Those 9 members at 42 for each hour, over 7.0 hours, stand in the value at 2646.

Were the same booking to carry no confirmed guarantee entry and a working count of 55, neither count would reach the smallest guest count of 60 printed against the package, and no contracted staffing would stand in the value at all.
